newsitem.title: UK: Copper ends sharply lower on nervy LME.
newsitem.headline: Copper ends sharply lower on nervy LME.

text.p: COPPER - Ends weak near lowest since early-Jan. Hit by liquidation, as spread premiums contract sharply. Cash/threes at $245/250, against $335 yesterday. Nearbys still high, however.
ALUMINIUM - Closes easier, hit by chart-related sell-off.
LEAD - Closes lower, near 1-1/4 year low. ZINC - Ends down.
NICKEL - Closes easier, but above low. TIN - Finishes softer.
